description: Report whether this server can pay for a read: the buyer wallet address, where discovery looks, the budget left, and in plain language the next step to get a paid read working (fund the wallet, or point discovery or the gate at your own publisher). Call it first, and again when naulon_discover or naulon_pay_and_read returns nothing or refuses. It is free, takes no arguments and changes nothing.
name: naulon_status

balanceUsdc.description: What the paying wallet can spend right now, in USDC, when the host can read it. null = the read failed (unknown, not zero). Absent = this server cannot see the balance.

discovery.description: Where naulon_discover looks for candidates (RSS_URL > PUBLISHER_URL/rss.xml > CATALOG_URL).

nextStep.description: Plain-language guidance for what to do next, given the current config.

ready.description: True once a wallet address is resolvable. When `balanceUsdc` is present it also requires a balance above zero; without it, ready does NOT mean funded.

remainingUsdc.description: Budget left for this session: the most it will spend from here.

settlement.description: The settlement chain + token this wallet tolls on. Read settlement.testnet FIRST: true ⇒ every spend is testnet play-money with no fiat value; false ⇒ real money.

chainName.description: Human network name, e.g. arcTestnet / base.

explorer.description: Block-explorer origin for this chain when known — settlementRef is viewable at <explorer>/tx/<ref>. Omitted when no verified explorer exists for the chain.

network.description: CAIP-2 network id, e.g. eip155:5042002 (Arc Testnet) — the chain the toll settles on.

testnet.description: TRUE = testnet play-money with NO fiat value (faucet-funded); FALSE = real-money mainnet. Report this honestly — never call a testnet toll 'real money'.

token.description: The token every toll is paid in.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract address on this chain.

tollgate.description: The single configured pay-gate (TOLLGATE_URL), when self-hosting one. Absent for the fleet default — there is NO universal fleet pay-gate; each discovered publisher tolls at its own origin.

wallet.description: The buyer wallet address (0x…40 hex) that pays every toll. ABSENT when this process has no wallet it can honestly name — a hosted mount with no session open, or a deploy with neither BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY nor BUYER_ADDRESS. Absent is the truthful answer, never an address to fund; `ready` is false and `nextStep` says how to get one.

title: Check wallet, discovery, and gate status
